description: Department of Public Enterprises - Order of Increase Paid-up Capital of the Bank of Ceylon
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends the Bank of Ceylon Ordinance (Chapter 397) by increasing the bank's paid-up capital. It contains a statutory instrument (Order under Section 7(2)) issued by the Minister of Finance, which constitutes subsidiary legislation modifying the legal framework governing the Bank of Ceylon. While it mentions the Minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on modifying banking regulations rather than government personnel or structural changes.
